questions.question: A detailed pencil sketch on white paper of a moon snail sand collar (egg casing) resting on a sandy Florida beach, drawn in graphite. The sand collar has a curved crescent or comma shape resembling a thick curled ribbon, with a dark hollow circular opening in the center. The top surface catches light and is lightly shaded to show a gritty, sandy texture, while the interior hole and underside are deeply shaded with rich dark tones. Surrounding the object is coarse beach sand with tiny shell fragments and granules rendered with fine stippling and small marks. Strong contrast between the bright sunlit upper curve and the deep shadowed hollow. Realistic graphite pencil drawing style, medium detail, slightly textured paper visible.
